answer.explanation: InvoiceController (presentation) imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository (persistence), and its cancel() method calls repo.markCancelled directly. This skips the business layer, so a state-changing write bypasses InvoiceService. FF-S03 flags presentation-to-persistence edges that skip layers. The README declares strict layering, says a controller never imports a repository, and says every write goes through InvoiceService. The code does exactly what that line forbids, and no doc or comment grants an exception.
